candidates.name: Arvind Ranjit
candidates.headline: Senior Applied AI Engineer at Piramal Finance | Agentic Systems · Fraud Analytics · GenAI | BITS Pilani
candidates.summary: BITS Pilani dual-degree engineer with ~4 years at Piramal Finance, rising from intern to Senior Applied AI Engineer. Owns a remarkable breadth of production systems — face recognition outperforming vendors, LangGraph agentic pipelines automating 78% of doc workflows, Bank Statement Analyzer replacing 80% of vendor stack at 97% lower cost. ET BFSI Exceller Award 2025. Interviewer flagged as top recommendation with exceptional ownership mindset.
candidates.narrative: Arvind Ranjit is a BITS Pilani graduate (dual degree: EEE + Economics) with approximately four years of applied AI experience, spent entirely at Piramal Finance where he rose from intern to Senior Applied AI Engineer. While single-company tenures can signal stagnation, Arvind's case is the opposite: the scope of systems he has owned — face recognition at 98.6% accuracy and 0.001 FAR, fraud analytics engines at millisecond latency, LangGraph agentic pipelines automating 78% of document workflows, and Bank Statement Analyzer pipelines replacing 80% of vendor workflows at 97% lower inference cost — rivals output from engineers spread across multiple companies. He has been recognized externally (Economic Times BFSI Exceller Award 2025) and internally (three Monthly Superstar Awards). Interviewer notes flag exceptional clarity of thought and a pronounced ownership mindset; he is actively seeking a smaller, higher-autonomy environment — a clear signal that ambition is outpacing his current context rather than absent. The primary gap is absence of multi-company or early-stage startup exposure, leaving resilience in pre-PMF ambiguity somewhat unproven.
candidates.raw_text: Senior AI Engineer with experience building production AI systems across GenAI, NLP, Computer Vision, Fraud Analytics, and Financial Services. Skilled in architecting agentic workflows, fine-tuning language models, deploying scalable ML systems, and delivering enterprise AI solutions with measurable business impact. Entire career at Piramal Finance, growing from intern to Senior Applied AI Engineer.

candidate_education.school: BITS Pilani – KK Birla Goa Campus

candidate_experiences.title: Data Scientist Intern
candidate_experiences.description: Built face recognition models and APIs handling 15% of production traffic. Developed document parsing pipeline using Layout Transformers, improving extraction accuracy and reducing manual verification time by 90%+.
candidate_experiences.note: Converted to full-time Data Scientist on graduation

candidate_experiences.title: Data Scientist
candidate_experiences.description: Designed a domain-adaptive language model framework using LoRA fine-tuning on frozen SLM backbones with modular classification heads for scalable multi-task and multi-label learning. Built a production-grade voice agent platform integrating retrieval, memory, tool execution, and workflow orchestration through a plugin-based architecture. Architected agentic document processing workflows using LangGraph automating 78% of processing workflows. Architected Bank Statement Analyzer and Account Aggregator pipelines replacing 80% of vendor workflows and reducing inference cost by 97%. Architected configurable entity resolution framework with 60+ tunable parameters. Developed LLM-assisted address matching system reducing vendor spend by 94%. Engineered low-latency fraud analytics engine delivering millisecond-scale responses. Designed graph-based fraud detection system for syndicate cluster and relationship network identification. Engineered real-time customer deduplication system for sub-second resolution. Led multimodal vehicle valuation pipeline integrating OCR, segmentation, and generative AI. Developed dual-branch face recognition architecture achieving 98.6% accuracy at 0.001 FAR, outperforming incumbent vendor solutions. Developed OCR-based KIE system with geolocation validation and cross-document consistency checks.
candidate_experiences.note: 97% inference cost reduction · 94% vendor spend reduction · ET BFSI Award 2025

candidate_experiences.title: Senior Applied AI Engineer
candidate_experiences.description: Architecting a DAG-based execution engine for Bank Statement Analysis supporting automatic dependency resolution, partial execution, and iterative workflows for scalable financial data processing and feature generation. Architected a configuration-driven multimodal feature engineering platform with automatic parallelization, caching, and task-definition versioning, enabling data scientists to create and deploy new AI workflows using YAML specifications and prompts without application code modifications.

candidate_projects.name: E-commerce Reviews Decoded
candidate_projects.summary: Co-authored research on LLM-based review evaluation, improving usefulness prediction through advanced prompting and analysis. Accepted at IEEE ACOIT 2025.

candidate_projects.name: Route Rover
candidate_projects.summary: Built backend for an LLM-powered trip planning system with structured itinerary generation and validation pipelines. Designed heuristic-based correction layer for LLM output reliability. Implemented near zero-cost multi-vendor search pipeline with heuristic matching integrating Google Places API.

candidate_projects.name: Smart Traffic Light System
candidate_projects.summary: Real-time traffic optimization system using object tracking to prioritize emergency vehicles and reduce congestion in simulations.

candidate_projects.name: Financial & Social Data Modeling
candidate_projects.summary: Built predictive models using XGBoost and NLP pipelines to identify key drivers in financial sentiment and public health datasets.
